items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: Like I tell you, he played extra with me.

ctx.x: That's our dance. I wondered about Ramus, your oldest brother. Which brass band did he work with?

Allen was his famous band. That was the main one. Allen, the old man Henry Allen brass band. Mm-hmm. Was his favorite band. And he played bass drummers there. He was strictly the bass drum player in that band because...

Allen's brother was a snare drum player, George Allen. He lived over there, but he went back home and died in Morgan City. He got two old cities. Did he play in any of the other bands? Yeah, he played extra with the other bands. Like I tell you, he played extra with me. When I was, they tell me to get the Trummel House in Barnes, they tell me, I said, well they had to do this right across the street for me. He said, Bill, you play Trummel today, get your brother on a drum. I said, okay, we have a funeral like…
